insights: **760 companies, 8 domains, 50 niches.** Local AI is a full stack, from NPUs to personal apps, not one market.
**On-prem beats on-device.** 439 companies target customer datacenters vs 119 for phones. "Local" mostly means private infrastructure.
**Silicon is crowded and mature; software is young.** 74 of 110 model companies and 35 of 45 personal-AI players were founded 2020+, vs 20 of 135 chip firms.

**Money follows physical AI.** Among core (non-borderline) independents, Vertical & Physical AI raised the most ($19B, led by Anduril Industries, Shield AI, Field AI); personal local AI the least ($0.6B).
**NVIDIA is the gravity well.** Top acquirer (8 deals incl. Run:ai, Deci, OctoAI) and co-builder of Palantir's Sovereign AI OS: five joint launches in 11 months.
**Chipmakers are buying the software layer.** NVIDIA 8, AMD 6, Qualcomm 5 of 85 tracked deals: runtimes, compilers, dev platforms (Edge Impulse, Modular, Nexa AI, Silo AI).
**Biggest overlaps: Models × Runtimes (30) and Runtimes × Ops (22).** Model makers ship their own engines. Serving engines grow into cluster ops.
**Focus is the norm.** 390 of 760 companies sit in a single niche; the multi-domain players are mostly big tech.
**White space:** portable & web runtimes, local creative tools, healthcare & life sciences, personal AI servers & home AI each have fewer than 10 companies.
**Shakudo's niche (private AI OS) has 23 players**, from Dataiku, Domino and Cloudera to Kamiwaza, webAI and Zylon. The battle is open-source breadth plus run-anywhere Kubernetes.

steps: 11 research agents swept market maps, partner directories and funding news, one segment each: 1389 mentions, 893 unique candidates.
Merged duplicates; removed community projects, consortia and generic tooling: 792 candidates.
21 agent batches confirmed scope and status, then profiled each company: 760 in scope, 45 rejected.
10 independent agents re-checked funding, status, founding, HQ and headcount for 400 key independents: 101 confirmed, 224 corrected, 75 unverifiable.
8 problem-framed domains and 50 niches derived from what companies do. Agents mapped every company (1 main + up to 3 secondary niches); weak fits drove v2.
Overlap = a company active in 2+ domains. Crowding and white space = companies per niche. Everything is saved as JSON/CSV.
caveats: Inference on hardware the customer controls: device, edge, on-prem, private cloud, air-gapped, sovereign. Cloud-API-only vendors excluded.
331 companies where local AI is a secondary line are kept and labelled **borderline**.
Total disclosed equity in USD for independent companies, all purposes (not only local AI). Public and big-tech firms show 'Public'.
Estimates from LinkedIn and aggregator snippets; treat as ±30%.
Each profile carries per-field confidence and a basis. 536 of 760 profiles used live web search; the rest rely on model knowledge and are flagged low/medium.
As of 25 Nov 2026. Events after mid-2026 depend on web search coverage and may be incomplete.
